plugins.name: parenting-frameworks
plugins.description: Parenting & Education Framework Guide — meta-router for 16 frameworks (Positive Discipline, PET, CPS, Emotion Coaching, Triple P, Attachment Parenting, SDT, Retrieval Practice, Growth Mindset, UbD, PBL, Montessori, DAP, UDL, Formative Assessment, Differentiated Instruction). Invoke /parenting.

skills.name: attachment-parenting
skills.description: Attachment-Based Parenting (Bowlby, Ainsworth, Siegel) — Build secure attachment through sensitive responsiveness, the 4 S's, repair conversations, and the Circle of Security
headings: Repair: The Most Important Attachment Skill
skills.description_zh: 介绍依恋导向育儿框架，依据 Bowlby、Ainsworth 和 Siegel 的思路，通过敏感回应、4 S、修复对话及安全圈建立安全依恋。

skills.name: cps
skills.description: Collaborative & Proactive Solutions (Ross Greene) — 'Kids do well if they can.' Solve problems WITH children, not TO them. Plan B collaborative process.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Ross Greene 的协作与主动解决问题框架，强调儿童具备能力时能做好，与孩子共同解决问题，并采用 Plan B 协作过程。

skills.name: dap
skills.description: Developmentally Appropriate Practice (NAEYC) — a framework for early childhood education that promotes optimal learning and development by meeting children where they are, accounting for age, individual, and cultural factors.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 NAEYC 的发展适宜性实践框架，依据儿童当前发展水平，考虑年龄、个体及文化差异设计早期教育，促进学习和发展。

skills.name: differentiated-instruction
skills.description: Differentiated Instruction (Carol Ann Tomlinson) — a proactive approach to teaching that adjusts content, process, product, and learning environment based on students' readiness, interest, and learning profile to maximize growth for every learner.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Carol Ann Tomlinson 的差异化教学方法，按学生准备程度、兴趣和学习特点调整内容、过程、成果及环境，支持各类学习者成长。

skills.name: emotion-coaching
skills.description: Emotion Coaching (John Gottman) — Raise emotionally intelligent children through 5 steps: awareness, connection, empathic listening, naming emotions, and problem-solving with limits
headings: The Five Steps of Emotion Coaching
Step 1: Be Aware of the Child's Emotion
Step 2: Recognize as Opportunity for Connection
Step 5: Set Limits and Help Problem-Solve
skills.description_zh: 介绍 John Gottman 的情绪教练方法，通过觉察、连接、共情倾听、命名情绪，以及在界限内解决问题的五步过程，支持儿童情绪能力发展。

skills.name: formative-assessment
skills.description: Formative Assessment (Black & Wiliam) — assessment FOR learning, not just OF learning. Five key strategies and dozens of practical techniques to make student thinking visible and adjust instruction in real time.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Black 与 Wiliam 的形成性评价，运用五项关键策略及实践技术呈现学生思考过程，并据此及时调整教学，服务于学习改进。

skills.name: growth-mindset
skills.description: Growth Mindset (Carol Dweck) — the belief that abilities can be developed through dedication and hard work. Transform praise, feedback, and self-talk to build resilience and love of learning.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Carol Dweck 的成长型思维，将能力视为可通过投入和努力发展，调整表扬、反馈和自我对话，支持韧性与学习兴趣。

skills.name: montessori
skills.description: Montessori Method (Maria Montessori) — child-led education through prepared environments, sensory materials, mixed-age grouping, and respect for natural developmental rhythms. Over 100 years of practice across 20,000+ schools worldwide.
headings: Quick Reference: Curriculum Areas and Key Materials
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Maria Montessori 的儿童主导教育方法，包括准备环境、感官材料、混龄分组和尊重自然发展节奏。原说明称该方法已有百余年实践，覆盖全球两万余所学校。

skills.name: parenting
skills.description: Parenting & Education Framework Guide — Analyzes age, role (parent/teacher), and situation to auto-select the optimal combination from 16 parenting and education frameworks. Supports Positive Discipline, PET, CPS, Emotion Coaching, Triple P, Attachment Parenting, SDT, Retrieval Practice, Growth Mindset, UbD, PBL, Montessori, DAP, UDL, Formative Assessment, and Differentiated Instruction.
skills.description_zh: 根据儿童年龄、家长或教师角色及具体情境，从 16 种育儿和教育框架中选择组合。覆盖正面管教、PET、CPS、情绪教练、Triple P、依恋育儿、自我决定理论、提取练习、成长型思维、UbD、PBL、蒙台梭利、DAP、UDL、形成性评价与差异化教学。

skills.name: pbl
skills.description: Project-Based Learning (PBL) — students gain knowledge and skills by working for an extended period to investigate and respond to an authentic, engaging, and complex question, problem, or challenge.
headings: 2. Plan the Project (7 Essential Elements Checklist)
skills.description_zh: 介绍项目式学习，让学生在较长周期内研究并回应真实、有吸引力且复杂的问题或挑战，从中获取知识与技能。

skills.name: pet
skills.description: Parent Effectiveness Training (Thomas Gordon) — Problem ownership, Active Listening, I-Messages, and the No-Lose Method for resolving parent-child conflicts
headings: Tool 1: Active Listening (Child Owns the Problem)
The Shift — I-Message to Active Listening
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Thomas Gordon 的父母效能训练，通过问题归属、积极倾听、我信息和无输家方法处理亲子冲突。

skills.name: positive-discipline
skills.description: Positive Discipline (Jane Nelsen) — Adlerian psychology-based parenting that is Kind AND Firm simultaneously. Belonging + Significance as core needs.
headings: 3. Logical Consequences (4 R's: Related, Respectful, Reasonable, Revealed)
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Jane Nelsen 基于阿德勒心理学的正面管教，同时保持和善与坚定，并关注归属感和价值感两项核心需求。

skills.name: retrieval-practice
skills.description: Retrieval Practice + Spaced Repetition — strengthen long-term memory by pulling information out of your brain, not pushing it back in. The testing effect is one of the most robust findings in cognitive science.
skills.description_zh: 介绍提取练习与间隔重复，通过主动回忆强化长期记忆。原说明将测试效应描述为认知科学中较稳健的研究发现。

skills.name: sdt-parenting
skills.description: SDT Parenting (Deci & Ryan) — Support children's autonomy, competence, and relatedness. Autonomy-supportive vs. controlling parenting. Why rewards can backfire.
headings: What to Do Instead of Rewards
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Deci 与 Ryan 自我决定理论在育儿中的应用，支持儿童自主性、胜任感和关系感，比较支持自主与控制式育儿，并讨论奖励可能产生的反作用。

skills.name: triple-p
skills.description: Triple P Positive Parenting Program (Matthew Sanders) — Evidence-based 5-level system from universal prevention to intensive family intervention. Self-regulation framework for parents and children.
headings: Triple P Positive Parenting Program Skill
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Matthew Sanders 的 Triple P 正向育儿方案，从普遍预防到密集家庭干预分为五个层级，为家长和儿童提供自我调节框架。原说明将其描述为循证体系。

skills.name: ubd
skills.description: Understanding by Design (Wiggins & McTighe) — backward design framework that starts with desired results, determines acceptable evidence, then plans learning experiences. The gold standard for curriculum design.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Wiggins 与 McTighe 的 Understanding by Design 逆向教学设计，先明确预期结果，再确定可接受证据，最后安排学习体验。适用于课程设计。

skills.name: udl
skills.description: Universal Design for Learning (CAST) — a framework for designing flexible learning experiences that accommodate learner variability from the start, rather than retrofitting accommodations after the fact. Based on neuroscience of how humans learn.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 CAST 的学习通用设计框架，从设计之初就考虑学习者差异，提供灵活学习体验。原说明称其依据人类学习的神经科学。

headings: Or clone individual frameworks you need
Example 4: Classroom with Wide Skill Gaps (Teacher)
